vector-integrals-shift.alt: Two paths with the same velocity v(t) = 1, 2t - 2 for t from 0 to 2.8. The emerald path starts at (0, 0) and the blue path starts at (2, 1); the blue path is the emerald one shifted 2 right and 1 up. At t = 2 both carry the same vermillion velocity vector. The antiderivative of v is t, t squared minus 2t, plus a constant vector C: C = 0, 0 for the emerald path and C = 2, 1 for the blue one. The initial position picks C: r(t) = r(0) plus the integral of v.
